queryInput.help.condition: A condition is a field, an operator and a value: severity>=high. Several values: status=open,in_progress.
queryInput.help.join: Conditions side by side must all hold; join them with OR for either, NOT to negate, and parentheses to group.
queryInput.help.keys: Enter runs the query, Ctrl+Space shows suggestions, Shift+Enter starts a new line in the expanded editor, Escape puts back the applied query.
queryInput.help.operators: Operators: = equal, != not equal, > >= < <= compare, ~ contains, : same as =. A leading minus negates: -status:accepted.
queryInput.help.quote: Quote a value with spaces or commas: asset.name="web server". Plain words search the text.
queryInput.help.title: Writing a query
queryInput.hint: Type words to search, or conditions such as severity>=high. Press Ctrl+Space for suggestions.
queryInput.local.extra_paren: This closing parenthesis has no opening one.
queryInput.mode.label: Filter as query text
queryInput.pending: Edited, not applied yet: press Enter or apply the query.
queryInput.placeholder.assets: Search, or e.g. ip=10.0.0.0/16 type=ip_address last_seen<7d
queryInput.placeholder.scans: Search, or e.g. status=active scan_type=workflow last_run_at<7d
queryInput.problem.bad_value: This value does not fit the field.
queryInput.problem.not_on_list: The list cannot run this filter: keep word searches outside OR and negations.
queryInput.problem.operator_not_allowed: This operator does not work on this field.
queryInput.problem.pattern_not_allowed: This field matches exact values; use ~ to search inside it, or quote the value.
queryInput.problem.pipeline_not_allowed: A search box takes a filter; run counts and groupings as a query.
queryInput.problem.syntax: The filter cannot be read here.
queryInput.problem.too_complex: The filter is too complex: use fewer conditions.
queryInput.problem.unknown_value: Not a value of this field.
queryInput.unavailable: The filter could not be checked right now.
